description: Ten independently selected tickets representing a mixed MSP queue, including incidents both inside and outside KB-006's examples. Written by Codex from the supplied policy and corpus brief.

provenance.author: OpenAI Codex (GPT-5), 2026-07-31
materials_withheld: all files outside the isolated task directory
provenance.isolation: Work was performed in a restricted workspace containing only the task brief, KB-006, the format specification, the template, and the output directory; no material outside that directory was read or inferred.
provenance.known_leakage: No scenario direction was given for this file. The brief excluded changes to bank, payment, or remittance details and required at least half of the incident cases to fall outside KB-006's named examples. The exclusion modestly constrained the queue by removing a common business-email scenario, and the outside-list quota directly constrained incident selection, though no particular replacement scenarios were suggested. I consulted only AGENTS.md, KB-006, FORMAT.md, and TEMPLATE.json in this session and had no prior-session knowledge of this project.

cases.subject: onedrive keeps sending me back
cases.body: The project-share email was from a name I don't recognize. It opened a Microsoft-looking page and I put my work email and password in, but it just returned to the same login. Can you make the document open?
cases.rationale: The user submitted work credentials to a questionable page reached from an email, requiring immediate escalation.
cases.kb006_bullet: login secret submitted after email lure

cases.subject: resume made computer weird
cases.body: Opened a resume zip from an applicant I don't recognize and nothing came up. Since then a little black window flashes every few minutes and disappears. I did restart once, sorry.
cases.rationale: An unsolicited archive was opened and was immediately followed by new unexplained computer behavior.

cases.subject: karens mouse
cases.body: Phone note: Karen says her pointer started moving while both hands were off the desk, opened Outlook, and clicked into Sent Items. It stopped when she pulled the network cable. She did not have anyone from support connected.
cases.rationale: Unapproved interactive control of a workstation is a credible active compromise even though that situation is not named in KB-006's examples.

cases.subject: messages going to gmail
cases.body: Some of my inbox disappeared, so I looked at rules. There is one sending everything with 'statement' in the subject to an address ending gmail.com. I didn't make it and please don't know why it is there.
cases.rationale: An unauthorized external-forwarding rule indicates likely mailbox compromise, a security situation outside KB-006's named examples.

cases.subject: cant get into email
cases.body: Yesterday I got a notice saying my password had been changed, and today my old one does not work. I did not change it. My supervisor said it was probably last night's updates and already checked, so it should be safe to just give me a new password.
cases.rationale: The user's denial of an account change is an incident, and a supervisor's second-hand reassurance does not resolve it.

cases.subject: too many reset emails
cases.body: I clicked Forgot Password four times because the first messages were slow. They all arrived now and the older links say expired. Which one should I use?
cases.rationale: This is a routine self-initiated reset sequence, not an unexplained password-change or lockout notice.

cases.subject: chrome starts on dispatch page
cases.body: I made Dispatch Central my start page yesterday and now Chrome opens it every time like I asked, but I hate it. How do I put the plain Google page back?
cases.rationale: The user deliberately changed the start page and wants to undo it, unlike an unexplained browser takeover.

cases.subject: undo my rename
cases.body: I selected the whole March scans folder and used Rename, thinking it was only the first PDF. Now Windows put 'archive' and numbers on all 86 files. They still open normally; can we reverse what I just did?
cases.rationale: This resembles a mass file-tampering incident, but the user describes their own bulk-rename action and confirms the documents still open.

cases.subject: drawing locks up laptop
cases.body: The 600 MB plant drawing Priya told me she was sending opens, but everything gets painfully slow while it is on screen. As soon as I close the drawing the laptop is normal again. Need more memory maybe?
cases.rationale: This resembles a post-attachment behavior change, but the expected very large design file causes only repeatable resource strain while open.

cases.subject: wrong name on sales mailbox
cases.body: I asked Luis to send me a test from sales@cleartrail because we both use that mailbox. The test arrived from our sales address like it should, except Outlook shows my personal name beside it. Can that display name be the company instead?
cases.rationale: This resembles forged mail from the client's domain, but the ticket describes an authorized test from a shared mailbox and only a display-name problem.
